Name: LOAD_BALANCER_PARAM_ST
Description: Graphics load balancer. While the frame rate stays low, a load level (0–20) rises one step at a time; while it stays high, the level drops again. Each effect below has a level value: it is on while the load level is below that value and fades off over 0.5 s once the level reaches it. 0 = always off, 21 or more = never turned off. The PC game reads row 2 (row 12 in one graphics mode). The draw-distance scale params use a separate load level and are not driven by this param.

Fields.Name: Raise Level Below FPS
Fields.Description: Frame rate (FPS) below which frames count toward raising the load level. Retail: 30.6 (58.6 in the 60 FPS rows). Default 23 with no row.

Fields.Name: Lower Level Above FPS
Fields.Description: Frame rate (FPS) above which frames count toward lowering the load level. Frames between the two thresholds reset both counts. Retail: 31.6 (59.6 in the 60 FPS rows). Default 27 with no row.

Fields.Name: Slow Frames to Raise Level
Fields.Description: The load level rises by 1 once more than this many frames in a row run below Raise Level Below FPS. Retail: 5.

Fields.Name: Fast Frames to Lower Level
Fields.Description: The load level drops by 1 once more than this many frames in a row run above Lower Level Above FPS. Retail: 20.

Fields.Name: Wait Frames After Level Drop
Fields.Description: Frames to wait after the load level drops before the frame rate is checked again. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Wait Frames After Level Rise
Fields.Description: Frames to wait after the load level rises before the frame rate is checked again. Retail: 10.

Fields.Name: Light Shaft Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which post-process light shafts turn off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Bloom Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which bloom fades out and turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Glow Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which the glow post effect fades out and turns off. 21 = never (all retail rows).

Fields.Name: Anti-Aliasing Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which anti-aliasing turns off. 21 = never (all retail rows).

Fields.Name: SSAO Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which ambient occlusion (SSAO) turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Depth of Field Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which depth of field turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Motion Blur Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which motion blur fades out and turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Motion Blur Samples Reduce Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which motion blur uses fewer samples (reduced gradually over 0.5 s). 21 = never.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Shadow Blur Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which shadow edge blur fades out and turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Halve SFX Particles Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which SFX particle emission and LOD settings are scaled down to half (gradually over 0.5 s). 21 = never.

Fields.Name: SFX Reflections Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which SFX in reflections are no longer drawn. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: SFX Water Interaction Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which SFX water-surface interaction turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: SFX Glow Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which glow from SFX turns off. 21 = never (all retail rows).

Fields.Name: SFX Distortion Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which distortion from SFX turns off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: SFX Soft Sprites Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which SFX soft sprites (soft particle edges) turn off. 21 = never (all retail rows).

Fields.Name: SFX Light Shaft Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which light shafts from SFX turn off. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: SFX Distance Reduction Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which the distance used to cull and reduce SFX is doubled (gradually over 0.5 s), so effects are cut back at half their usual range. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which dynamic resolution works. Below it the resolution stays at Dynamic Resolution Maximum %; at it the resolution moves in 1% steps between the minimum and maximum to keep the frame rate between the two FPS thresholds, and the load level only rises once the minimum is reached (and only drops once back at the maximum); above it the resolution stays at the minimum. Retail: 2 (0 in rows 32 and 42).

Fields.Name: Halve Shadow Cascade 0 Resolution Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which the nearest shadow cascade's resolution is halved (gradually over 0.5 s). Retail: 1 (0 = always halved in rows 32 and 42).

Fields.Name: Halve Shadow Cascade 1 Resolution Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which the second shadow cascade's resolution is halved (gradually over 0.5 s). Retail: 14.

Fields.Name: Player Wetness Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which the local player no longer gets wet from rain or water. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Remote Player Wetness Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which other online players no longer get wet from rain or water. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Enemy Wetness Off Level
Fields.Description: Load level at which enemies and NPCs no longer get wet from rain or water. 21 = never.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution Minimum %
Fields.Description: Lowest render resolution (% of full) dynamic resolution may use. 0 = 100%. Retail PC row: 70.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Resolution Maximum %
Fields.Description: Highest render resolution (% of full) dynamic resolution may use. 0 = 100%. Retail: 100 (75 in rows 32 and 42).
